name: nightly-timeout
task: find out why the nightly build times out and fix it
latest: The integration step runs every suite one after another with no limit per suite. I will split it in nightly.yml so each suite is its own step with its own timeout.

steps.result:
name: nightly
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 3 * * *'
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: make build
      - name: integration
        run: scripts/integration.sh
